author: Ifmyante
text:
To those of you who've taken the time to review RTM in FPA; thank you so much for your time and touching comments

Thanks also to everybody who contributes, with homework and analysis. Your journeys are an inspiration to all who follow.

Massive thanks to those who take the time to wander around the site
helping new members find their feet. RTM would be nothing without you.

As you've probably noticed, my life goals have evolved dramatically
since we started RTM, and I'm delighted to have the support of so many
to help make them happen.

My role in RTM has diminished due to this, but I always hoped that the RTM community would take over from me.

I'm so proud to see that it has!

Very well done everybody. You're the measure of what a community should be

patterns they create in the market. They have the ability to cause
confusion in the market , and so they use it to take the amatures'
money.

At one time i was talking to that IT trader, I asked him how he uses
manipulation. He went to the whiteboard, and show me how he and hos team
 were causing confusions, with his pencil he draw me all sorts of

it makes him money on everyday basis.

In conclusion, I agree with you trading like IT is total different thing
 then following the IT. We as traders should expect their manipulations.
 once we see the confusion happening, we should know they come to
action.

author: bulbuli
text:
Hi everyone !! I would like to chime in, please correct me seniors if I am wrong

Amit, I think technical analysis or Price action itself means that we
are following Institutional Investors. We are analyzing zones and
patterns (like QMs and diamonds) of the past ,which itself were created
by the action of ITs, and we are trading those zones which have
unconsumed orders left (or predictable order flow). And your favorite
setup of trading swaps itself needs action by ITs or else you would not
have seen swaps behave the way they do now.

Also trading like ITs would mean analyzing and trading intrinsic value
of an instrument or having large enough money pool to trick retailers
and find liquidity in markets and then trade it for your advantage.

So for us, we are actually looking at the charts to get clues about IT actions and trading those clues and actions.

This is just my understanding of course, please rectify if incorrect !!

Yes. You are correct. IT means having huge fund to move the market and
to create fake moves and create patterns. This clears me that there are 3
 kind of traders :

1 : Retail Traders (Buffalo, Deer, Zebra)

2 : Institutional Traders (Lion, Tiger)

3 : IT follower traders (Analyzes the activity of IT and trade with their flow) (Hyena)

We don't want to be retails sellers because most of the looses money.

We can't be Institutional trader right now because we don't have enough fund to move the market

So, there is last option we are learning skills of no. 3 traders.

I wanted to ask you a question about a failed trade I had today. Now I

me, I can't seem to find anything wrong with the logic or execution? I
go by what I call the Sttar method (Space, Trend, Timing, Approach,
Reaction) and this checked out on all of those. I also looked at the
Euro in comparison to other pairs and though it didn't look very strong
overall, I trusted my analysis fully and patiently waited for the return
 to my preferred area.

Here is my analysis of EURGBP that I posted in my journal about a week ago along with the summary I wrote.

Weekly

Daily

buying(long tails that spiked new demand) to boot!! We also have plenty
of room overhead for profit. I would favor a retest into the newly
created daily demand. And better yet, a nice visit to the 4hr demand
